actual_stopping_semantics.interpretation: Reached the 200-epoch maximum and patience 10 simultaneously. Best epoch 190 is followed by 10 non-improving epochs, so early_stopped is true at the cap. Exported checkpoint is the saved best-validation checkpoint under pinned source, not last_checkpoint.pt. No convergence claim.

coverage_read_scope: For the 32-fit rollup only, small completed model manifest JSON identities and prior native audit receipts were read; no prior fit binaries were re-audited.

freeze_timing_evidence.interpretation: Pinned driver/fit CLI ordering plus recorded command starts and current report mtimes agree with settings frozen before confirmation. Filesystem times are not independent tamper-proof timestamps.

limits: Best/last checkpoint bytes were hashed, not deserialized; native best-checkpoint restoration is supported by pinned source/history, not independently inspected model weights.
Post-transform training/validation matrix digests match the frozen cached baseline records; transformed counts were not regenerated or decoded.
Observed-to-export ID order was checked against frozen cached baseline public exports, with training IDs also matching the train-only gene manifest; H5AD count/observation arrays were not decoded.

State labels, biological transport costs, ridge probes and neighborhood/hubness diagnostics were not independently rerun. The run reaches the 200-epoch cap and patience 10 simultaneously, retaining best-validation epoch 190; this does not establish convergence or biological/causal correctness.
This single audited integration seed reuses frozen biological cells and does not create another independent biological world.

matrix_completion_metadata.scope: Marker/job partition and all16report JSON hashes only; no scoring rerun or session/process polling.

remaining_native_audit_limits: Checkpoint/optimizer tensors and GLUE model-state hashes were bound by bytes/source/receipts, not independently deserialized or replayed by these bounded audits.
GLUE native TensorBoard events were generally hashed and recorded native history summaries checked, not independently re-parsed in these audits.
Transformed count digests/retention were reconciled with frozen provenance and cached references; transformed count matrices were not independently regenerated.

These native artifact audits establish reproducible configuration/artifact chains, not biological integration correctness or causal recoverability. The separate pre-archive host-process visibility gap remains documented and is not a missing fit audit.
native_audit_coverage_across32.scope: Coverage is established by checkpoint/full-configuration identity against explicit native audit receipts and current small completed model manifests. The final fit is covered by this receipt. Previously audited model/public binaries were not re-audited for this rollup.

scope: Only the completed seed 1 scMRDR baseline confirmation fit, fixed cached baseline references, completed informative report metadata, and prior native audit receipts/small completed model manifests for a 32-fit coverage inventory. JSON/public train-val-discovery NPZ reads (including model-specific latent arrays), public H5AD/checkpoint byte hashes, source/version reads. No counts decoded, truth NPZ/private/protected biological cohort arrays, active scMRDR seed 1 or any other new partial output reads, checkpoint/model deserialization, CUDA, fits, causal evaluation or state/probe scoring reruns. Public ID sampling and arithmetic on recorded native losses/embedded report aggregates only.
